heading: Gating Mobile CI/CD with Call-Graph Reachability Analysis
core_technical_idea: Filtering SAST alerts by intersecting call graphs with entry points to block only reachable vulnerabilities.
must_show: Reachable vs dead code path branching
composition: Left-to-right data flow starting from mobile entry points, passing through call-graph reachability evaluation, splitting dead code from live paths, and culminating in a CI/CD build gate.

heading: Quantifying Alert Fatigue and the Cost of Unverified SAST Findings
core_technical_idea: Distinguishing between raw static alert volume and true runtime reachability based on the app's dex graph to eliminate false compliance failures.
must_show: Android App Bundle (AAB) or iOS IPA input
SAST syntactic/semantic pattern matching engine generating raw alerts (400 warnings)
Unreferenced utility libraries and unreachable helper classes filtered out
Reachable dex graph verification path mapped to OWASP MASVS checklist
True Risk vs. False Compliance metric separation
composition: Left-to-right processing pipeline showing the reduction of raw static findings down to true reachable risk via dex graph analysis.
alt_text: A technical architecture diagram showing mobile app binaries feeding into a SAST scanner, filtering unreferenced code paths through a dex graph to separate false alerts from true MASVS risks.
caption: Filtering static SAST alerts through dynamic dex graph reachability transforms 400 raw warnings into actionable, high-confidence risk metrics.
mermaid_code:
flowchart TD
    A[Production AAB / IPA Build] --> B[SAST Scanner Engine]
    B --> C[Raw Flood of Alerts: ~400 Warnings]
    C --> D{Dex Graph Analysis}
    
    D -->|Unreferenced Utility Libraries| E[Unreachable Code / Zero MTTR]
    D -->|Exported Components & Reachable Path| F[True Exploitability / MASVS Validation]
    
    E --> G[Suppressed Administrative Friction]
    F --> H[Targeted Remediation & True Risk Compliance]

    style C fill:#ffe6e6,stroke:#ff4d4d,stroke-width:2px
    style F fill:#e6f9ff,stroke:#00b3ff,stroke-width:2px
    style E fill:#f2f2f2,stroke:#b3b3b3,stroke-width:2px

heading: Mapping Attack Surfaces with Static and Dynamic Call-Graph Analysis
core_technical_idea: The derivation of an Interprocedural Control Flow Graph (ICFG) from application entry points to filter out unreachable dead code and isolate exploitable surfaces.
must_show: Exported Activities, Services, and URL Schemes
Reachable Code vs Dead Code / Unused SDKs branching
composition: Top-down hierarchical flowchart showing the transformation from platform entry points through the ICFG traversal down to filtered reachable and unreachable execution paths.
alt_text: A technical architecture flowchart demonstrating how application entry points from manifests feed into an Interprocedural Control Flow Graph to segregate reachable code from dead code.
caption: Filtering unexploitable dead code by traversing directed edges outward from the application's root set.
mermaid_code:
flowchart TD
    A[Android Manifest / Info.plist Entry Points] --> B[Exported Activities / Services / URL Schemes]
    B --> C[Interprocedural Control Flow Graph (ICFG)]
    C --> D[Reachable Code / Attack Surface]
    C --> E[Dead Code / Unused SDKs (Filtered Out)]

heading: Configuring CI/CD Security Gating Thresholds and Decision Matrices
core_technical_idea: Pipeline decision logic based on exploitability tiering, data sensitivity, and MASVS severity to prevent brittle binary pass/fail blocks.
must_show: Conditional branching for Block Pipeline, Warn & Flag, Log & Suppress, and Auto-Close
composition: Top-down flowchart mapping vulnerability input parameters through evaluation gates to distinct CI/CD actions.
alt_text: Decision tree diagram showing how exploitability status, data sensitivity, and MASVS category route findings to specific CI/CD pipeline actions like blocking, warning, logging, or auto-closing.
caption: Decision matrix routing logic mapping vulnerability reachability and context directly to deterministic pipeline actions.
mermaid_code:
flowchart TD
    Start([Vulnerability Finding]) --> Reachability{Exploitability Status?}
    
    Reachability -->|Verified Reachable| DataSens1{Data Sensitivity?}
    Reachability -->|Unreachable / Dead Code| DataSens2{Data Sensitivity?}
    
    DataSens1 -->|High: PII / Tokens| Action1[Block Pipeline
Immediate Fail]
    DataSens1 -->|Low: Telemetry| Action2[Warn & Flag
Non-blocking Alert]
    
    DataSens2 -->|High: PII / Tokens| Action3[Log & Suppress
File Cleanup Ticket]

Ignore in Reporting]

heading: Validating Pipeline Resilience Against Obfuscation and Dynamic Loading
core_technical_idea: Illustrate how static call-graph analyzers lose interprocedural edges due to obfuscation, reflection, and native boundaries, and how mapping integration restores reachability.
must_show: Broken ProGuard/R8 Mappings creating alphanumeric stubs (a, b, c)
Reflection & Dynamic Invocation (Class.forName, NSClassFromString) severing direct edges
Manifest root set and reachability validation path
composition: A top-down flowchart showing normal static analysis traversal splitting into three failure modes (Obfuscation, Reflection, Native Boundary) and their resolution pathways via mapping files and dynamic stubs.
alt_text: Mermaid diagram mapping pipeline resilience challenges including ProGuard symbol loss, reflection stubs, and JNI boundaries.
caption: Pipeline blind spots: how obfuscation, reflection, and native boundaries fracture static call graphs.
mermaid_code:
flowchart TD
    Root[Manifest Root Set] --> StaticAnalyzer[Static Call-Graph Analyzer]
    
    StaticAnalyzer -->|Normal Traversal| Reachable[Reachable Code]
    
    StaticAnalyzer -->|Failure Mode 1| Obfuscation[ProGuard/R8 Obfuscation]
    Obfuscation -->|Missing mapping.txt| Alpha[Randomized Symbols a, b, c]
    Alpha --> FalseNegatives[False Negatives & Broken Edges]
    
    StaticAnalyzer -->|Failure Mode 2| Reflection[Reflection & Dynamic Invocation]
    Reflection -->|Class.forName / NSClassFromString| DeadCode[Treated as Unreachable Dead Code]
    
    StaticAnalyzer -->|Failure Mode 3| Native[Native Bridge Blindness]
    Native -->|JNI / Interop Layers| Unresolved[Unparsed Export Tables]
    
    subgraph Resolution [Pipeline Safeguards]
        Mapping[Supply mapping.txt] -.-> Alpha
        Stubs[Account for Reflection Stubs] -.-> DeadCode
        Signatures[Parse JNINativeMethod] -.-> Unresolved
    end
